assumptions: Camera P is metric only within the stated calibration scope (court plane + net anchors).
Contact heights and positions are reviewed priors with stated sigmas, not measured contacts.
Drag coefficient is fitted per flight with a weak prior; speeds are model speeds, not radar measurements.
Landing regions constrain the model; the reported landing point is not a measured coordinate.
Low reprojection error shows 2D consistency only; it is not independent 3D accuracy proof.

provenance_vocabulary.observed_pixel: supplied 2D detection, unchanged (null when the detector reported none)
provenance_vocabulary.human_review: reviewed contact time/height/position, landing region or calibration point
provenance_vocabulary.conditional_model: gravity+drag model fitted to observed pixels under reviewed priors
provenance_vocabulary.display_interpolation: renderer-only drawing between model samples (trails, rings)
